name: Visa for short, medium or long stay
summary: Visitors need a visa before they travel. Visas are no longer sold on arrival, and showing up without one can get you hit with a penalty.

other: Details not confirmed on a Central African Republic government page, so check with a Central African embassy before applying

stay.note: Reported categories: short (under 1 month), medium (2 to 3 months), long (over 3 months).

steps: Contact the Central African embassy where you live, or the nearest French embassy if there is none.

sources.label: French foreign ministry travel advice for the Central African Republic
